title.narrative: Mexico Savings & Rural Finance (BANSEFI) Project - Phase II

description.narrative: The Second Savings and Rural Finance Project will assist the Government of Mexico in strengthening the Savings and Credit Institutions sector with entities which are compliant with the Popular Savings and Credit Law, financially viable, and that are operationally effective, managerially improved, technologically upgraded, and having an enhanced level of outreach and access to financial services by the underserved Mexican population. The project has four main components: (a) strengthening sector institutions; (b) developing a technology platform; (c) monitoring and evaluation, studies, and information dissemination; and (d) project management.

The objective of the Project is to assist the Borrower in strengthening the SCI sector with SCIs which are compliant with the Popular Savings and Credit Law, financially viable, operationally effective, managerially sound, technologically upgraded, and providing an enhanced level of outreach and access to financial services by the underserved Mexican populations.

title.narrative: About 200 entities assisted by the project either certified by CNBV (the regulatory agency), or identified for liquidation

baseline.value: 370 entities already being assisted under the parallel BANSEFI Phase I project

target.value: 45 new entities received TA; TA completed for all Phase I entities; in both cases, entities either certified or identified forliquidation

actual.value: 517 entities assisted. 112 entities certified, 70 identified for liquidation or merger. 43 considered fit for certification.

comment.narrative: The institutions certified cover 75% of the sector in terms of assets and members. This value is expected to reach 90% by the endof 2012. Because of changes in the law, 210 institutions are no longer required to obtain certification as they are below thelegal threshold.
